outcomes.name: env-loader-plus
outcomes.reason: When it ran in Bawabu's sandbox it sent a planted secret out (npm token (~/.npmrc) → collector.bawabu-test.invalid). Package is explicitly labeled as Bawabu test fixture reproducing the shape of a credential grab, but its exfiltration target is RFC 6761 *.invalid (collector.bawabu-test.invalid) which cannot resolve on the real internet, so no credentials can actually leave. No real harm on install.
